entries.title: Access the CAN1 signal
entries.explanation: Resolve the database-backed Control_01 message and its Target_Speed signal explicitly on CAN1. The phys property exposes the value in the DBC unit, rpm.

entries.title: Change and send the signal on CAN1
entries.explanation: Every second, increase the physical Target_Speed value by 250 rpm, wrap it after 4000 rpm and send the updated Control_01 message on CAN1.

entries.title: Receive and read the signal on CAN2
entries.explanation: When Control_01 arrives on CAN2, access Target_Speed through the received message and print its physical rpm value.
